
# Figure 6D reanalysis

## Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

base <- "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR"

df <- read_tsv(
  paste0(base, "/data/processed/6D_distance-bins-mm10.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## Calculate reporter expression
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    pool = sub("_.*", "", pool_barcode),
    IR_expression = (expression_counts_1 + expression_counts_2) /
                    (normalization_counts_1 + normalization_counts_2)
  )
```



## Summarize expression by distance bin
```{r}
# calculate median expression separately for each pool
pool_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(pool, side, distance_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    median_expression = median(IR_expression),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# calculate mean and SEM across pool medians
summary_6D <- pool_summary %>%
  group_by(side, distance_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expression = mean(median_expression),
    sem = sd(median_expression) / sqrt(n()),
    n_pools = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# calculate mean gene distance and number of IRs
distance_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(side, distance_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_distance_kb = mean(distance) / 1000,
    n_IRs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_6D <- summary_6D %>%
  left_join(
    distance_summary,
    by = c("side", "distance_bin")
  ) %>%
  arrange(side, distance_bin)

summary_6D

# save summary data
write_tsv(
  summary_6D,
  paste0(base, "/results/figure6D_summary.tsv")
)
```

## Plot Figure 6D
```{r}
# position Start on the left and End on the right
plot_df <- summary_6D %>%
  mutate(
    x = if_else(
      side == "Start",
      -30 - mean_distance_kb,
      30 + mean_distance_kb
    )
  )

p <- plot_df %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(x = x, y = mean_expression, group = side)
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -30, xmax = 30,
    ymin = 0, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey90"
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(0, mean_expression - sem),
      ymax = mean_expression + sem
    ),
    fill = "steelblue",
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1.5) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0, y = 0.1,
    label = "Gene",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-230, -130, -30, 30, 130, 230),
    labels = c("-200", "-100", "Start", "End", "100", "200")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-240, 240)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 6D Reanalysis",
    x = "Distance from nearest gene (kb)",
    y = "IR expression"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

p

ggsave(
  paste0(base, "/results/figure6D.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 5
)
```


## Focus on IRs within 50 kb of the nearest gene

```{r}
# Keep IRs within 50 kb and make 10 quantile bins for each side
df_50kb <- df %>%
  filter(distance >= 0, distance < 50000) %>%
  group_by(side) %>%
  arrange(distance, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(distance_bin_50kb = ntile(distance, 10)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate median expression for each pool, side, and bin
pool_summary_50kb <- df_50kb %>%
  group_by(pool, side, distance_bin_50kb) %>%
  summarise(
    median_expression = median(IR_expression),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate mean and SEM across pool medians
summary_50kb <- pool_summary_50kb %>%
  group_by(side, distance_bin_50kb) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expression = mean(median_expression),
    sem = sd(median_expression) / sqrt(n()),
    n_pools = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate mean distance and number of IRs
distance_summary_50kb <- df_50kb %>%
  group_by(side, distance_bin_50kb) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_distance_kb = mean(distance) / 1000,
    n_IRs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Combine summaries
summary_50kb <- summary_50kb %>%
  left_join(
    distance_summary_50kb,
    by = c("side", "distance_bin_50kb")
  ) %>%
  arrange(side, distance_bin_50kb)

summary_50kb

# Save summary data
write_tsv(
  summary_50kb,
  "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6D_50kb_quantile_summary.tsv"
)
```

## Plot Figure 6D within 50 kb

```{r}
plot_50kb <- summary_50kb %>%
  mutate(
    x = if_else(
      side == "Start",
      -5 - mean_distance_kb,
      5 + mean_distance_kb
    )
  )

p_50kb <- plot_50kb %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = mean_expression, group = side)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -5, xmax = 5,
    ymin = 0, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey90"
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(0, mean_expression - sem),
      ymax = mean_expression + sem
    ),
    fill = "steelblue",
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1.5) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0, y = 0.1,
    label = "Gene",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-55, -30, -5, 5, 30, 55),

  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-55, 55)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 6D Reanalysis (0–50 kb, quantile bins)",
    x = "Distance from nearest gene (kb)",
    y = "IR expression"
  ) +

p_50kb

ggsave(
  "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6D_50kb_quantile.png",

```
